**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no take-or-pay or minimum volume obligation binding Verizon Owner Trust 2020-A or Verizon ABS LLC:

- **No commitment language anywhere.** Searches for "minimum", "commit", "volume", "obligated to acquire" and "purchase" surfaced no committed-spend, take-or-pay or usage-cap provisions. Amounts we pay (Servicing Fee, Supplemental Servicing Fees) are consideration for services actually performed — the preferred position.
- **The one "shortfall" mechanic runs in our favour.** Section 4.3(h) (p0211) requires Cellco, as Marketing Agent, to deposit Credit Payments into the Collection Account where an Obligor Credit creates a Collections shortfall. That is a counterparty funding obligation benefiting us, so per the detection guidance it is not flagged.
- **Additional Receivables transfers are not a purchase commitment.** Sections 2.1(b) and 2.1(d) (p0034, p0037) are Depositor-to-Issuer transfers — both our parties — and are discretionary, conditioned on satisfaction of the Credit Enhancement Test and Pool Composition Tests. No obligation to acquire a minimum volume from Cellco.

Nothing sits even at the fallback because no commitment exists to narrow; the clause set meets the preferred position outright.
